related.title: GCN：自迴圈與對稱正規化
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付擴張樹、時間單位表與因果性測試。；256與512可重算，16與32ms換算正確且未來擾動測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver dilation trees, time-unit tables and causality tests.; Counts and durations match and future-perturbation tests pass.
related.difference: 列A、A+I、D與正規化矩陣四張2×2表；註明度數包含自迴圈。；3與5吻合，自迴圈與度數一致，排列測試通過。
related.differenceEn: List A,A+I,D and normalized adjacency as2×2 tables; degrees include self-loops.; Values3/5 match, self-loops agree with degrees and permutation tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 核寬2、擴張率1,2,…,2^(L−1)時，感受野1+Σd=2^L個樣本。；教學L=8，取樣率16000Hz；改L=9。；R=2^8=256樣本；L9時512樣本，分別16及32ms。
聚合矩陣D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2；兩互連節點加自迴圈後各度2，權重皆1/2。；教學節點值2與4，線性權重1、無激活；第二值改8。；y1=.5×2+.5×4=3；第二值8時y1=5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With width-two kernels and dilations1,2,…,2^(L−1), receptive field is1+Σd=2^L samples.; Teaching eight layers at16000Hz, then nine layers.; R=2^8=256 samples; nine layers give512, corresponding to16 and32ms.

Aggregate with D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2; two linked nodes with self-loops have degree2 and weights1/2.; Teaching node values2 and4, linear weight1 and no activation; change second value to8.; y1=.5×2+.5×4=3; changing the second value to8 gives5.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: BatchNorm：批次統計與推論狀態
related.titleEn: BatchNorm: batch statistics and evaluation state
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付擴張樹、時間單位表與因果性測試。；256與512可重算，16與32ms換算正確且未來擾動測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver dilation trees, time-unit tables and causality tests.; Counts and durations match and future-perturbation tests pass.
related.difference: 列批次、通道及空間軸，註明此題母體變異；把running統計與當批統計分開。；兩值吻合，母體/樣本變異慣例明示，eval批次不變性測試通過。
related.differenceEn: Label batch,channel and spatial axes, specifying population variance here and separating running from batch statistics.; Values match, variance convention is explicit and evaluation batch-invariance tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 核寬2、擴張率1,2,…,2^(L−1)時，感受野1+Σd=2^L個樣本。；教學L=8，取樣率16000Hz；改L=9。；R=2^8=256樣本；L9時512樣本，分別16及32ms。
y=γ(x−μ)/√(variance+ε)+β；統計軸與訓練/推論狀態必須明確。；教學同通道兩值2,4，均值3、母體變異1；取x4,ε1e−5,β0,γ1，再改γ2。；y=1/√1.00001=.9999950000；γ2時1.9999900001。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With width-two kernels and dilations1,2,…,2^(L−1), receptive field is1+Σd=2^L samples.; Teaching eight layers at16000Hz, then nine layers.; R=2^8=256 samples; nine layers give512, corresponding to16 and32ms.

y=gamma(x−mean)/sqrt(variance+epsilon)+beta; define reduction axes and train/eval state.; Teaching values2,4 have mean3 and population variance1; x4,epsilon1e−5,beta0,gamma1 then2.; y=1/sqrt1.00001=.9999950000; gamma2 gives1.9999900001.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
